response.description: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to undergo sexual reproduction in order to differentiate the individuals or types involved.
response.label: biological sex

response.description: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer or a population by virtue of the bearer's disposition to survive and develop normally or the number of surviving individuals in a given population.
response.label: viability

response.description: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual or a population that only produces gametes that can be fertilised by male gametes.
response.label: female

response.description: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual or a population whose sex organs contain only male gametes.
response.label: male

response.description: A biological sex quality inhering in an organism or a population with both male and female sexual organs in one individual.
response.label: hermaphrodite

response.description: The exact number may be one or two different from the 2n number and still be classified as diploidy (although with aneuploidy). Nearly all mammals are diploid organisms, although all individuals have some small fraction of cells that are polyploidy.
response.label: diploid

response.description: The rate or speed of the change in size of an individual entity or change in number of a population.
response.label: growth rate

response.description: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual or a population by virtue of having internal reproductive organs of one sex and external sexual characteristics of the other sex.
response.label: pseudohermaphrodite

response.description: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual or a population by virtue of having internal reproductive organs of male and external sexual characteristics of female.
response.label: male pseudohermaphrodite

response.description: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual or a population by virtue of having internal reproductive organs of female and external sexual characteristics of male.
response.label: female pseudohermaphrodite

response.description: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual or a population that undergo sexual reproduction.
response.label: mating type

response.description: Acinus is Latin for berry.
response.label: acinar

response.description: Note that the chromosomal constitution of genotypic sex varies in different organisms. In human, we have XY, XX, though abnormal XXY, X0, XYY, and other combinations are possible.
response.label: genotypic sex

response.description: Note that the chromosomal constitution of genotypic sex varies in different organisms. In human, this would be XY, though abnormal XXY and XYY would also result in a male phenotypic outcome.
response.label: male genotypic sex

response.description: Note that the chromosomal constitution of genotypic sex varies in different organisms. In human, this would be XX, though abnormal X0 and XXX would also result in a female phenotypic outcome.
response.label: female genotypic sex

response.description: The rate or speed of the change in size of an individual entity.
response.label: single organismal growth rate

response.description: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual or a population who are otherwise male of a non-hermaphroditic species who has ambiguous or atypical congenital development of the reproductive system.
response.label: male with DSD

response.description: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual or a population who are otherwise female of a non-hermaphroditic species who has ambiguous or atypical congenital development of the reproductive system.
response.label: female with DSD

response.description: A quality inhering in a process by virtue of that process having a population or part of a population, where population is defined as a collection of individuals from the same taxonomic class distinguished by one or more characteristics, as participants.
response.label: population process quality

response.description:
A quantitative quality that represents the sum of all 'mass' qualities of the component parts that constitute a whole entity. The total mass quality inheres in the whole entity and reflects the aggregate measure of mass across all its components, such that changes in the mass of individual components may not necessarily correspond to equivalent changes in the total mass of the whole.

Example of usage: "total body mass" represents the sum of the masses of all tissues and organs in the body, while "liver mass" represents only the mass of the liver. An increase in liver mass does not necessarily mean an increase in total body mass, as the mass of other organs or tissues may decrease simultaneously.
response.label: total mass
